summary: 0 of 65 requested trading days successfully backfilled this session. This is disclosed honestly, not padded. See 'root_cause' and 'architectural_limitation' below.

architectural_limitation.description: Independent of network health, only ONE of the 8 (category x market) endpoint combinations is even CAPABLE of returning genuine historical data for an arbitrary past date. Verified by grep-searching both cached swagger definitions (loop/evidence/raw_samples/{twse,tpex}_swagger.json) for query parameters on every relevant path -- zero were found on: TWSE STOCK_DAY_ALL (ohlcv), TWSE MI_MARGN (margin), TWSE MI_INDEX (market_index), and EVERY TPEx OpenAPI endpoint used by this system (ohlcv/institutional/margin/market_index). These endpoints always return their latest trading day regardless of what date is requested -- a genuine backfill attempt against them would either (a) silently receive today's data mislabeled as the requested historical date, which the new date-consistency guard (src/data_fetcher.py::extract_payload_date) now catches and drops as DATE_MISMATCH, or (b) simply not vary output by date at all. Only TWSE T86 (institutional, https://www.twse.com.tw/rwd/zh/fund/T86, a legacy RWD endpoint pre-dating the OpenAPI swagger) genuinely honors a date= query parameter -- live-confirmed earlier in this session: requesting date=20260601 returned a payload whose top-level 'date' field echoed back '20260601' with 1,326 real data rows.
architectural_limitation.conclusion: Even under perfect network conditions, this session's --backfill run against categories=[ohlcv, margin, market_index] and TPEx institutional would have produced exactly 0 newly-usable historical files -- every attempt would hit DATE_MISMATCH (payload always reports 'today', never the requested past date). This backfill run was therefore correctly restricted to categories=['institutional'] (TWSE + TPEx), the only category with any chance of a genuine historical result for TWSE, plus an honest attempt at TPEx (which does NOT support a date parameter per swagger and would also always DATE_MISMATCH if it reached that check).

root_cause_this_session.description: This sandbox's outbound network to both TWSE and TPEx hosts experienced a SUSTAINED (not merely 'intermittent' as M4's report described) total outage during the ~12 minutes this backfill ran before being aborted by the operator. Every single connection attempt (14 total: 7 trading days x 2 markets) failed with a hard 30-second connect timeout after all 3 retry attempts each.
root_cause_this_session.independent_verification: PowerShell Resolve-DnsName openapi.twse.com.tw / www.tpex.org.tw both resolved to 10.0.0.1 (an unreachable sinkhole address) at the start of this session, matching M4's previously-documented sandbox DNS-interception quirk (docs/Milestone_4_Acceptance_Report.md §5.3) but qualitatively worse: M4 described occasional per-invocation variability with some endpoints succeeding; this session observed 100% failure across every attempt for the ~12-minute window the backfill ran, plus separate single-endpoint probes both before and after that also failed, with the sole exceptions being two isolated successful windows (TWSE/TPEx official-mapping fetch at 07:40 and the 2026-07-17 daily report bridge files already on disk from a prior session).
root_cause_this_session.operator_decision: Aborted the backfill after 7 consecutive trading days (14 fetch attempts) all failed with the identical connection-timeout signature, rather than continue burning ~2 minutes per day for an estimated 65 days (~2+ hours) with no evidence of network recovery. This decision prioritizes honest, timely reporting over an artificially 'completed-looking' but potentially still-mostly-failing multi-hour run.

twse_historical_availability_verdict: TWSE historical data IS obtainable, but ONLY for institutional flow (T86 endpoint). OHLCV, margin, and market index are all latest-day-only on TWSE too (verified: STOCK_DAY_ALL/MI_MARGN/MI_INDEX all have zero query parameters per the cached OpenAPI swagger). This session's network outage prevented actually retrieving any of the 65 requested days even for the one endpoint capable of it.
recommendation_for_future_sessions: Re-run 'python scripts/fetch_daily_data.py --backfill 2026-04-20 2026-07-17' (or a targeted institutional-only variant) once this sandbox's network is confirmed healthy (Resolve-DnsName should return a real IP, not 10.0.0.1). The resumable skip_existing behavior (default in the CLI) means re-running is safe and will not re-fetch/re-request any day that happens to have already succeeded. A true multi-month historical OHLCV/margin/market_index dataset is NOT achievable via these TWSE/TPEx OpenAPI endpoints regardless of network health -- an alternative bulk-historical data source (e.g. FinMind, as the original spec allowed) would be required for that; T86 institutional flow is the only category where the currently-integrated endpoints can genuinely backfill.
